name: Steps
description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step process, such as checkout or setup: done, current and upcoming steps. It displays progress; you control the steps and buttons.

currentStep.description: The step the person is on, starting at 1. Earlier steps show as done.

orientation.description: Lay the steps in a row or a column.

label.description: Accessible name of the list, e.g. "Checkout progress".

requirements: An ordered list with an accessible name; each step is a list item
Each step also says its state in words for screen readers (Completed, Current step, Not started), not only with an icon or color
Completed steps use a check icon, the current one a filled number, upcoming ones an outline: shapes differ, not only colors
Not interactive: if people can click a step, make it a link or button yourself
screenReader: Announced as a list with the number of steps
Each item reads its number, title and state, e.g. "Step 2, Payment, current step"

use_when: Checkouts, onboarding and wizards with a known number of steps
Telling people how much is left
avoid_when: Steps that can be done in any order: use a checklist
Navigating between pages: use Tabs or Breadcrumbs
anti_patterns: Using color alone to show the current step
Making steps clickable without keyboard access
